description: Gives every window the rounded corners, hairline outline and drop shadow that libadwaita apps already have. All values are read from libadwaita's stylesheet and your ~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css, so light/dark, high contrast and gtk.css changes are followed automatically. Optional settings round maximized windows, choose which apps are rounded and give apps a style of their own. No GNOME Shell methods are patched.
name: Rounded Corners Sharp
